nodes.intent: the landing: the shore fire, and the water at the end
nodes.note: The beach under the barrow field, where the party comes ashore at low water. The brother keeps the shore fire here; at its seaward edge a line of old tide stones marks where the water stops.

stations.note: Beside the shore fire near the south end of the field, where the brother keeps it.
The wet sand at the field's south edge, where the tide stops.

nodes.intent: the barrow field: the bier, the rite, the grave row and the open cut
nodes.note: An open barrow field on a tidal islet under the foot of the keep wall. The keep gate is in the north wall; a black banner stands over the bier in the middle of the field; the grave row runs along one side to an open cut. The field opens straight onto the beach below it.

stations.note: Just inside the keep gate, where the lamp-bearer comes out with the wake-lamp.
Under the black banner in the middle of the field, where Wren Ashlaw lies on her plank.
Beside the bier on its east side, where the lamp-bearer sets the wake-lamp down.
At the foot of the bier, where a mourner has stood since morning.
On the west flank among the old barrows, where an elder stands at his family's grave.
On the east flank by the dyke, where a child keeps its distance.
Beside the second barrow east of the bier, as far in as the child comes.
The warden's post at the head of the open cut, at the west end of the grave row.
The head of the grave row, between the cut and the bier, where the rite is said.
